keyPhrases.text: performs like a parody of Ibsen
There's so much going on that small things like an incestuous affair... can get lost
Act 2 devolves into several long dissertations
can't help but put on a good show
can't be blamed for failing to make sense

reasoning: Review is predominantly critical of the play's construction and execution, calling it a 'parody' and criticizing plot elements as 'clumsy' and convoluted. While praising technical elements (set, projections) and some performances, the overall tone suggests the production fails to work as drama. Falls clearly in negative territory but not a complete pan.
